title: User enrolls in MFA with email verification
gherkin:
Feature: MFA Enrollment
  Scenario: User successfully enrolls in MFA using email
    Given a user is logged into the system
    When the user navigates to security settings
    And the user selects email as the MFA method
    And the user provides their email address
    Then a verification code is sent to the email
    And the user receives the verification code
    And the user enters the verification code
    Then MFA is successfully enabled for the user account
rationale: Validates the basic MFA enrollment process using email as a second factor, ensuring users can set up MFA protection on their accounts.
generationSummary: MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) capability test suite covering user enrollment, authentication flows, factor verification, and security scenarios for a system implementing multi-factor authentication.

title: User logs in with MFA enabled

title: User account locked after multiple failed MFA attempts
gherkin:
Feature: MFA Security
  Scenario: User account is locked after multiple failed MFA attempts
    Given a user has MFA enabled on their account
    When the user enters their username and password
    And the credentials are valid
    Then the user is prompted for the second factor
    And the user enters an incorrect MFA code 5 times
    Then the user account is temporarily locked
    And the user receives a notification about the lockout
    And the user cannot attempt login until the lockout period expires
rationale: Validates that the system implements brute-force protection by locking accounts after multiple failed MFA attempts, enhancing security.
